dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: The structure of ships here in Sumeru is interesting indeed. Hmm, inspiring, too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. I was just studying the ships here at Port Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Though Raimondo is likely going to order a "reorganization" of my project... which really means terminate.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: But I've spent too long on this research to just let it go.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but start to compare the differences in design between these ships and aquabuses...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your travels...

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Nothing special, really. I could have come directly to Sumeru from Fontaine... after all, there's a line going straight to the Bayda Harbor in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: But to make the trip a bit more interesting, I went to Liyue via Lumidouce Harbor and Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: After that, I took a ferry to Port Ormos from Liyue Harbor. Then I traveled northwards along the river, and here I am.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: When I return, I may trek across the desert, and return via Romaritime Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: ...However, I have plenty of Mora left, so crossing the desert to Natlan sounds nice, too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Goodbye, then. I'll continue my observations. Fascinating, indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is an aquabus?

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: In Fontaine, a kind of transportation system called aquarails.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Aquabuses are dedicated vehicles that use them.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: If you ever find yourself in Fontaine, you should definitely ride one.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: Not only are they fast and convenient, but they even have Melusine guides on board who will provide commentary on the scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Augustus Lovelace
dialogues.text: I swear, I am not exaggerating in the least when I say that riding an aquabus is simply a sublime experience.
